narr: Thunderstorms produced locally heavy rain in northern Delaware from the late afternoon into the nighttime hours of June 26. Rainfall totals were as high as 2 to 5 inches.
ev: Minor flooding occurred on the White Clay Creek downstream from Newark.
Old Ogletown Road in Brookside was closed between DE Route 273 and Augusta Drive due to flooding.
Governor Printz Boulevard was closed in Edgemoor between Lea Boulevard and Edgemoor Road due to flooding.
At least 20 vehicles were stranded in flood waters in Claymont. Some water rescues were required.
Minor flooding occurred along the Christina River around Cooch's Bridge.
